icp: self-directed retail swing trader with a full-time job
pain_point: Information asymmetry and time poverty — retail traders compete against institutions with billion-dollar data budgets while juggling a 9-to-5, resulting in 96% failing to make a livable income
visual_hook: Split-screen whip-pan: LEFT — hedge fund trading floor, wall of Bloomberg terminals, quants sprinting past server racks. RIGHT — retail trader at kitchen table in hoodie, single laptop, coffee going cold. Center frame slams together with a digital glitch transition revealing a bold counter: '4%'.

scenes.visual: Split-screen whip-pan: LEFT — hedge fund floor, Bloomberg terminals glowing, quants sprinting past server racks. RIGHT — retail trader at kitchen table in hoodie, single laptop, coffee going cold. Center frame slams together with digital glitch transition revealing bold counter: '4%'.
scenes.sfx_or_music_note: Sharp synth hit on glitch transition, then low tension drone

scenes.visual: Extreme close-up on the counter: '4%' pulses, then morphs to '96% fail'. Camera pulls back through the kitchen window — morning commute traffic blurs past, clock on wall ticks 6:47 AM. Trader's phone buzzes: missed alert.
scenes.voiceover: Ninety-six percent of retail traders never make a livable income. Not because they're lazy — because they're outgunned and out of time.
scenes.sfx_or_music_note: Ticking clock layered under drone, phone buzz vibration

scenes.visual: Cinematic data visualization: fiber-optic cables pulsing light across a globe map — New York, London, Singapore. Cut to: hedge fund server room, rows of blades processing 10M+ data points/sec. Overlay text: '$BILLIONS spent on speed & alternative data'.
scenes.voiceover: Hedge funds spend billions on alternative data, microwave towers, and teams of PhDs. You get... a free screener and Reddit.
scenes.on_screen_text: Institutions: $BILLIONS on data • Retail: Free screeners

scenes.visual: POV shot: trader in office cubicle, spreadsheet minimized, sneaking glances at phone. Split screen: candlestick pattern forms on chart — missed entry. Text appears: 'Information asymmetry costs retail traders billions annually.'
scenes.voiceover: Research confirms it: information asymmetry costs retail traders billions every year. You're trading blind while the pros see the whole board.
